desc: Threaded Barrel with Self-Indexing Compensator kit. This drop-in system is designed to work with any standard configuration Hellcat 9mm pistol and features a black Melonite finish for rust-resistance and lubricity as well as 1/2x28 threading. The compensator, included with the threaded barrel, helps reduce muzzle rise and perceived recoil. For use in any 3" Hellcat pistol configuration.
